title: The Idle Anti-Thesis
author: captainlispers
selftext:
I'm currently in incredibly early development of a spiritual successor for Anti-Idle the Game.

I loved the game when I was younger and I've heard 0 news about a sequel. its been over a decade so I thought I would try and pull from my nostalgia and increase my portfolio.

Im going to try to make it where its more centered around each minigame being a full experience with the main aspect of the idle/anti-idle tying it all together in the background

[https://youtu.be/zoVkZbl8GQA](https://youtu.be/zoVkZbl8GQA)

its just started so nothing serious but to follow guidelines-[https://captainlispers.itch.io/the-idle-antithesis](https://captainlispers.itch.io/the-idle-antithesis) \- This is where you can play what I've created so far

AI Disclosure- I'm new to coding and such so I am receiving help when getting stuck via Claude and Codex. Its been incredibly helpful. Asking questions like, How would you handle this? and seeing what it says, and manipulating it to see what happens has been incredibly insightful!

With the multitude of minigames, I feel like this would help me the most with expanding my horizons when it comes to Game Dev. Let me know what you guys think, thank you!
